summary: Froze the docs-only contract for period precheck, the four reconciliations (cash, settlement, revenue, cost/fee) and difference semantics at BASE d81c11c. New docs/v1.0-development/period-precheck-contract.md defines the read-only projection period.precheck.snapshot/v1 aligned with canonical PeriodPrecheck/period.precheck.get/v1: input signature (member, scope company|project, project_id, period, as_of, sections; no client amounts/differences/status), output envelope (precheck + four domain checks/differences/issues/missing/summary + precheck_digest), reuse of the existing single-source read interfaces (cash_bridge_snapshot, open_item_coverage_snapshot, revenue_pairing_snapshot, bank_charge_pairing) with their owner issue codes, exact difference identities and null propagation, issue/missing schema with blocker-vs-warning mapping, period/lock/close boundaries referencing existing AccountingPeriod/PeriodCloseRun/ProjectClose facts, cross-owner read-only refs, permissions (owner/finance/auditor, pm project summary, member denied, history_read when disabled), precheck_digest definition and the PH-353 submission rule (server recompute; precheck_stale/precheck_blocked rejection; client digest is not authorization), evidence/acceptance commands and counterexamples. The PH-363 spec now carries a freeze summary. No code, migration, table, route, product behavior or canonical schema change was made; the capability remains unimplemented and is delegated to PH-181/PH-185 with PH-353 as consumer.

deviations: The contract intentionally freezes a read-only projection (period.precheck.snapshot/v1) that extends canonical period.precheck.get/v1 with derived checks/differences/issues/missing; it explicitly states that publishing those fields as a public query requires a separate canonical version-bump planning slice, not this docs-only freeze.

The four reconciliation domains reuse existing owner read services and their issue_code vocabularies verbatim (cash bridge, settlement coverage, revenue pairing, bank charge pairing) instead of redefining rules; period precheck only aggregates and adds period/lock determination.
Cash offset (PH-241) and insights read models (PH-272) are not delivered; the contract represents them as offset_implemented=false/missing rather than treating them as zero or implemented.

precheck_digest binds a read-only precheck snapshot for PH-353 import submission; it is not an amount authorization and must be server-recomputed, with stale/blocked rejection. No persistence table is added by this contract; PH-353 owns storing the digest with its submission.
No code, migration, table, route, contract schema, gate or acceptance-command change; the capability remains not implemented (PH-181/PH-185 follow-up).
